title: BB defending vs an early raise
keyIdea: You already have 1bb in, so calling is cheap (about 27% equity needed). But early ranges are strong: defend with pairs, suited hands and strong offsuit aces.

actions.call: JJ-22, AQs-A2s, KTs+, QTs+, J9s+, T9s, 98s, 87s, 76s, 65s, AQo-AJo, KQo

notes.A2s: Suited aces defend cheaply: nut flush potential and you're already invested.
